newsitem.title: USA: Dorrance plans to sell more Campbell shares.
newsitem.headline: Dorrance plans to sell more Campbell shares.

text.p: John Dorrance III, grandson of the Campbell Soup Co founder, said Thursday he will make "additional dispositions" of shares he still owns in the company.

Dorrance's disclosure was made in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission and comes after Campbell disclosed that the retired director had sold a major block of the company's stock in the open market earlier today.
In the filing, Dorrance said he sold 9,614,996 shares of Campbell at prices ranging from $80 to $81.125 a share in private and open market transactions.
The shares sold represented approximately 66.2 percent of his holdings in the company and reduced his stake to 2.3 percent or 5,373,481 common shares, Dorrance said.
"As opportunities become available, his present intention is to make additonal dispositions when economically advantageous," Dorrance said in the filing.
"Such future dispositions may be substantial," he said.
